metadata.hash_rule: File difference hash = sha256( ("identical"|"differs") + "\n" + unified_diff_text ), where unified_diff_text is the output of `diff -u -L canonical/<canonical_path> -L copied/<copied_path> <canonical file> <copied file>`. For copied-only/canonical-only rows the hash is sha256( ("copied-only"|"canonical-only") + "\n" + hex(sha256(file bytes)) ). Labels are fixed so hashes are machine-independent and reproducible.
